summary.text: Carter Nordman, a Republican, represents District 47 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Nordman as serving a third term and as a financial advisor.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Nordman graduated from Adel-DeSoto-Minburn High School in 2017, studied one year at DMACC, and graduated from the University of Northern Iowa in 2021 with a degree in business administration and management.
It says Nordman was born in 1998 in Waterloo, was raised in Adel and lives in Dallas Center.
